sloka: विभीषणश्च धर्मात्मा लङ्कायां धर्मामाचरत् ।शोषाः सर्वे महाभागा ययुर्मधुपुरं प्रति ।। ७.२५.३५ ॥
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇaśca dharmātmā laṅkāyāṁ dharmāmācarat ।śoṣāḥ sarve mahābhāgā yayurmadhupuraṁ prati ।। 7.25.35 ॥

translations.english: The righteous Vibhishana remained in Lanka practicing dharma, while all the other illustrious remaining ones went towards Madhupura.
